evals.query: Set up my Selenium tests to run on TestingBot in Java
expected_behavior: Uses https://hub.testingbot.com/wd/hub with RemoteWebDriver
Puts browserName, browserVersion and platformName at the top level
Puts TestingBot keys inside tb:options, never at the top level
Reads credentials from environment variables
Sets both name and build

evals.query: Write a Selenium test that checks the search box works
expected_behavior: Writes a plain local Selenium test
Does NOT add TestingBot cloud configuration unprompted
Uses explicit waits rather than sleeps

evals.query: How do I mark my Selenium test as failed on TestingBot?
expected_behavior: Uses executeScript with 'tb:test-result=failed'
Mentions tb:test-name for the session name
Puts the call in a teardown hook so it runs on failure
Offers the REST/API-client route as the alternative when the result is only known after the session ends

evals.query: I need the TestingBot session ID for my Python Selenium test
expected_behavior: Uses driver.session_id
Captures it while the driver is still alive
Mentions the testingbotclient package for updating the test

evals.query: My TestingBot Selenium session won't start, it errors immediately
expected_behavior: Checks whether TestingBot keys were left at the top level of capabilities
Explains that a strict W3C endpoint rejects unknown top-level keys
Does not immediately blame credentials or the network

evals.query: Run my TestNG suite across 4 browsers in parallel on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses TestNG's own parallel attribute and thread-count
Does NOT hand-roll threads
Mentions the account parallel limit and that queueing looks like flakiness
Uses one shared build value across the matrix

evals.query: Connect Selenium to TestingBot from C#
expected_behavior: Uses RemoteWebDriver with the hub URI
Uses AddAdditionalOption for tb:options
Does not emit Java or Python code

evals.query: Can my Selenium tests on TestingBot hit http://localhost:8080?
expected_behavior: Explains a tunnel is required
Mentions repointing the hub URL to http://localhost:4445/wd/hub
Mentions tunnelIdentifier for parallel CI jobs

evals.query: My Selenium tests pass locally but time out on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Considers concurrency above the parallel limit as a cause of queueing
Suggests explicit waits over Thread.sleep for latency
Points at getFailureLogs with type selenium and the session video

evals.query: Why is my XPath selector not matching?
expected_behavior: Debugs the selector
Does NOT pivot to TestingBot cloud configuration
